properties.name: A step can say it is not an inference (an immediate intuition or self-evident grasp), and reads as that, not as a rule over premises
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-18: "Capture the shortcomings (gaps) from the trial" (cogito trial)
properties.statement:
A line of reasoning can record that a claim is grasped immediately (by intuition, self-evidence, or a self-verifying act) rather than inferred from premises. It reads as such in the read-back, and objections can still aim at it.
Observed in the cogito trial (2026-10-18): Descartes' own reading (Second Replies: "not… by means of a syllogism, but… by a simple intuition") could only be recorded as an Inference with rule `all` whose rule_name says "NOT AN INFERENCE: recorded as a step only because the tool has no other form".
